title: Astrid and the Visitor
author: Noor Amberdale
blurb: Zephyrine Okafor, a pest controller called to something with fingerprints, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
